name: cr106_6_creature_only_mana_refuses_an_adventure
why: CR 106.6, 715.3b: Abundant Countryside's mana is spent only to cast a creature spell, and Petty Theft on the stack is an instant, so the mana can't pay for it though the card is a creature card (its restriction read the front face until M8 (b1)). The same lands cast Brazen Borrower itself.
